test.create_query: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS {database}
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {database}.{table}
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {database}.mut_upd
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {database}.mut_upd_part
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {database}.mut_del
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {database}.mut_del_part
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {database}.evo
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS {database}.evo_mod

CREATE TABLE {database}.nation ( n_nationkey Int32, n_name String, n_regionkey Int32, n_comment String ) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/iceberg_suite_write_nation_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet')

CREATE TABLE {database}.region ( r_regionkey Int32, r_name String, r_comment String ) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/iceberg_suite_write_region_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet')

CREATE TABLE {database}.part ( p_partkey Int32, p_name String, p_mfgr String, p_brand String, p_type String, p_size Int32, p_container String, p_retailprice Float64, p_comment String ) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/iceberg_suite_write_part_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet')

CREATE TABLE {database}.supplier ( s_suppkey Int32, s_name String, s_address String, s_nationkey Int32, s_phone String, s_acctbal Float64, s_comment String ) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/iceberg_suite_write_supplier_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet')

CREATE TABLE {database}.partsupp ( ps_partkey Int32, ps_suppkey Int32, ps_availqty Int32, ps_supplycost Float64, ps_comment String ) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/iceberg_suite_write_partsupp_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet')

CREATE TABLE {database}.customer ( c_custkey Int32, c_name String, c_address String, c_nationkey Int32, c_phone String, c_acctbal Float64, c_mktsegment String, c_comment String ) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/iceberg_suite_write_customer_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet')

CREATE TABLE {database}.orders ( o_orderkey Int32, o_custkey Int32, o_orderstatus String, o_totalprice Float64, o_orderdate Date, o_orderpriority String, o_clerk String, o_shippriority Int32, o_comment String ) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/iceberg_suite_write_orders_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet')

CREATE TABLE {database}.lineitem ( l_orderkey Int32, l_partkey Int32, l_suppkey Int32, l_linenumber Int32, l_quantity Float64, l_extendedprice Float64, l_discount Float64, l_tax Float64, l_returnflag String, l_linestatus String, l_shipdate Date, l_commitdate Date, l_receiptdate Date, l_shipinstruct String, l_shipmode String, l_comment String ) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/iceberg_suite_write_lineitem_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet')

CREATE TABLE {database}.mut_upd ( l_orderkey Int32, l_partkey Int32, l_suppkey Int32, l_linenumber Int32, l_quantity Float64, l_extendedprice Float64, l_discount Float64, l_tax Float64, l_returnflag String, l_linestatus String, l_shipdate Date, l_commitdate Date, l_receiptdate Date, l_shipinstruct String, l_shipmode String, l_comment String ) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/iceberg_suite_write_mut_upd_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet')

CREATE TABLE {database}.mut_upd_part ( l_orderkey Int32, l_partkey Int32, l_suppkey Int32, l_linenumber Int32, l_quantity Float64, l_extendedprice Float64, l_discount Float64, l_tax Float64, l_returnflag String, l_linestatus String, l_shipdate Date, l_commitdate Date, l_receiptdate Date, l_shipinstruct String, l_shipmode String, l_comment String ) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/iceberg_suite_write_mut_upd_part_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet') PARTITION BY toMonthNumSinceEpoch(l_shipdate)

CREATE TABLE {database}.mut_del ( l_orderkey Int32, l_partkey Int32, l_suppkey Int32, l_linenumber Int32, l_quantity Float64, l_extendedprice Float64, l_discount Float64, l_tax Float64, l_returnflag String, l_linestatus String, l_shipdate Date, l_commitdate Date, l_receiptdate Date, l_shipinstruct String, l_shipmode String, l_comment String ) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/iceberg_suite_write_mut_del_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet')

CREATE TABLE {database}.mut_del_part ( l_orderkey Int32, l_partkey Int32, l_suppkey Int32, l_linenumber Int32, l_quantity Float64, l_extendedprice Float64, l_discount Float64, l_tax Float64, l_returnflag String, l_linestatus String, l_shipdate Date, l_commitdate Date, l_receiptdate Date, l_shipinstruct String, l_shipmode String, l_comment String ) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/iceberg_suite_write_mut_del_part_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet') PARTITION BY toMonthNumSinceEpoch(l_shipdate)

CREATE TABLE {database}.evo ( l_orderkey Int32, l_partkey Int32, l_suppkey Int32, l_linenumber Int32, l_quantity Float64, l_extendedprice Float64, l_discount Float64, l_tax Float64, l_returnflag String, l_linestatus String, l_shipdate Date, l_commitdate Date, l_receiptdate Date, l_shipinstruct String, l_shipmode String, l_comment String ) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/iceberg_suite_write_evo_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet')

CREATE TABLE {database}.evo_mod ( l_orderkey Int32, l_partkey Int32, l_suppkey Int32, l_linenumber Int32, l_quantity Float64, l_extendedprice Float64, l_discount Float64, l_tax Float64, l_returnflag String, l_linestatus String, l_shipdate Date, l_commitdate Date, l_receiptdate Date, l_shipinstruct String, l_shipmode String, l_comment String ) ENGINE = IcebergLocal((SELECT value FROM system.server_settings WHERE name = 'user_files_path') || '/iceberg_suite_write_evo_mod_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/', 'Parquet')

ALTER TABLE {database}.mut_upd UPDATE l_quantity = l_quantity + 1 WHERE l_partkey % 10 = 0
ALTER TABLE {database}.mut_upd_part UPDATE l_quantity = l_quantity + 1 WHERE l_shipdate >= toDate('1995-06-01') AND l_shipdate < toDate('1995-07-01') AND l_partkey % 10 = 0
ALTER TABLE {database}.mut_del_part DELETE WHERE l_shipdate >= toDate('1996-03-01') AND l_shipdate < toDate('1996-04-01') AND l_suppkey % 10 = 0
ALTER TABLE {database}.evo_mod MODIFY COLUMN l_partkey Int64
SELECT count(), countIf(l_extra IS NULL) FROM {database}.evo
SELECT count() FROM {database}.evo WHERE l_comment_v2 LIKE '%special%'
